description: Laser-focused on DTC ecommerce and paid ads world. Every DTC brand needs constant video ad creatives. High budget. High volume. Recurring need. Perfect FASTECH fit.
target_personas: Ecommerce brand owners running Meta/TikTok/YouTube ads
DTC founders posting about ad performance, ROAS, scaling
People posting about AI ads, AI creative, AI video for ads
Brands actively spending on video ad creatives
UGC agencies and ad creative agencies serving ecommerce
People talking about DTC, dropshipping, Shopify brands, product launches

target_decision_maker.note: The person posting about ads is usually the decision maker. Go direct.

email_angle: Lead with their specific pain — ad creative fatigue, needing more video variations, scaling creative output. Reference their niche (DTC, Shopify, Meta ads) specifically. NEVER send a generic video editing pitch. Speak their language: ROAS, creative fatigue, testing velocity, UGC.
pain_points_to_reference: Running out of video ad creatives to test
Needing more video variations at speed
Scaling ad spend but creative output can't keep up
UGC costs too high / too slow
AI-powered creative is the next competitive edge
subject_line_examples: your Meta ad creatives — quick thought
how DTC brands are solving creative fatigue
more video variations without hiring a team

extract_fields: tone — casual DTC founder or professional marketer
